title: An incredible run for Buena Vista Social Club
transcript: Buena Vista Social Club announced that it is closing on January 17th, and if you have not seen this musical, I highly, highly recommend trying to catch it before then or catching it on the tour that it currently is doing. What an incredible run for this musical. This was part of the insanely stacked 2025 season, and it's. It truly showcases what the bio jukebox musical could be, because this is a jukebox musical based off of the album of the same name that also is sort of adapted from the documentary of the same name. But the way that they're able to weave together the music of this album with the story of both the reuniting of this group and the creation of this group is so incredibly well crafted. It's so good that it feels wrong to classify it as a biopics musical, but that is what it is. It's just. It's so well crafted in the way that they create the story in the musicianship on stage. This, as a reminder, won a special Tony nomination for the band, and deservedly so. They are literally so, so good. What an incredible run for a really fantastic musical. And if you have not got a chance to see it yet, try to before January 17th. This is also currently on tour. Try to catch it if it's coming to a city near you. I really, really enjoy this one. I think there's a lot to love about Buena Vista social club. And I'm. I'm sad it's closing.
